Messages.Author: Vasco
Messages.Body:
I just want to be clarified about something.
In the storyline infernal minions (in card text like Midget) still
just pay one pool to untap right?

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <797866f.04110...@posting.google.com>, Vasco


No. The Infernal Plague rules are quite explicit:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=plague
"If the vampire's card text already identifies him as infernal, the
infernal pool penalty is increased by one pool (the controller must burn
2 pool or tap that vampire)."

If you are playing "non-infernal" and you have Midget in your crypt, you
still only must pay the 1.

>
> http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/index.php?line=plague
> "If the vampire's card text already identifies him as infernal, the
> infernal pool penalty is increased by one pool (the controller must burn
> 2 pool or tap that vampire)."

Just in case it wasn't clear, I suspect that the double penalty
applies only to infernalist players:

"Every vampire in the crypts of the players who join with the
infernalists (including all vampires in the crypts of the Baali
players) gains the infernal attribute (see section 4 of the rules). If

the vampire's card text already identifies him as infernal, the
infernal pool penalty is increased by one pool (the controller must
burn 2 pool or tap that vampire"

Note the "in the crypt of players who join the infernalists" statement
in the beginning of the paragraph.
I understand that a player with a crypt composed of, let's say, 9
Setites and 3 Baali and do NOT accept getting into the infernalist
team does NOT pay double penalty if he happens to influence out a
Baali, just the normal one pool per untap.
